sections.title: Switch between Test and Live catalogs
sections.excerpt: Switch between Test and Live catalogs | The Test and Live tabs hold two completely separate product catalogs, each with its own count badge. Start in Test while you're still validating — it can't charge real cards. Always glance at which tab is selected before you create or edit a product, so it lands in the right catalog.

sections.title: Keep the mode consistent everywhere
sections.excerpt: Keep the mode consistent everywhere | A product only works at checkout if the paywall screen, your Stripe connection, and this tab are all in the same mode. A real launch needs a Live product with a Live Stripe connection; a safe rehearsal needs a Test product with a Test connection. Mixing modes is the most common reason a paywall fails to charge.
